verdict.rationale: Attio documents people and companies as default objects and says objects can be linked through its graph model, so linked contact and company records are covered. The activity-timeline half rests on one marketing line about 'full history of every interaction' and is not documented as a per-record timeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-record activity timeline on contacts and companies, documentation of the specific people-to-company relationship attribute, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Attio comes with two objects enabled by default, people and companies
Link objects to make your data actionable and insightful with our powerful graph model.
Get instant visibility into the full history of every interaction.
